flagged.title: War Communism, Kronstadt and the NEP
flagged.reason: The video states that the 1921–22 Volga famine was caused by losing Ukraine under the 1918 Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, giving students an incorrect cause and anachronistic sequence for an examined syllabus topic.

mark_affecting.quote: and losing Ukraine's grain belt from the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, this huge drop in farming triggered a catastrophic famine in the Volga region in 1921 and 1922

flagged.title: Terror, Purges and the Cult of Stalin
flagged.reason: The video states that five of eight Red Army marshals were executed (there were only five marshals, three of whom were shot) and claims Trotsky was airbrushed out of photos of Lenin's funeral (he was absent from the funeral).

mark_affecting.quote: Five of the Red Army's eight marshals? Executed.
Five of the Red Army's eight marshals? Executed.
Trotsky was famously airbrushed out of pictures of Lenin's funeral.

flagged.title: The Great Patriotic War, 1941-1945
flagged.reason: The video states that Stalin signed the German surrender in Berlin on 9 May 1945, whereas Stalin signed nothing and Marshal Zhukov signed for the Soviet Union.

mark_affecting.quote: That push, ultimately ended with Stalin signing the German surrender in Berlin on the 9th of May 1945, which became Victory Day.
